# External Data Directory (`data/external/`)

This directory stores external lookup tables, attack category mappings, protocol type definitions, and schema mappings used across datasets:
- `attack_mapping_nsl_kdd.json`: Maps 38 specific attack sub-classes to 4 major categories (DoS, Probe, R2L, U2R).
- `attack_mapping_cicids2017.json`: Maps CICIDS2017 attack types to normalized NetShield severity levels.
